Terra Fresca · Brand Board · v1

Terra Fresca

One brand, two arms: Terra Fresca Trading (the export house, leaf-green world) and Terra Fresca Market (the future US retail, terracotta accent). Fresh earth — carried across the ocean.

Color System

Terra Ink#0C1F12Type, dark grounds, the road
Leaf Deep#14532DTrading surfaces, service band
Leaf#2E9E5BSupport green, freshness cues
Paper#F7F6ECPrimary ground — market paper
Mango#FFA51FTHE accent. CTAs, highlights, one per view
Terracotta#C4572ETerra Fresca Market only
Lime#A8C838Small labels on dark green
Papaya#FF6B4AProduce illustration only — never UI

Typography

Archivo Expanded Black

Display voice — headlines, wordmark, numbers. Width 125, weight 900, all caps, tight leading. Google Fonts, free for commercial use.

IBM PLEX MONO · TELEMETRY & LABELS · 7.0°C

The operations voice — tickers, eyebrows, data, stamps. Letterspaced uppercase, 10–12px. Free for commercial use.

Logo Candidates

RECOMMENDED · primary mark

01 · The Seal

Vector SVG · Recraft

Export-stamp heritage: the mark a buyer trusts on a crate. Works as favicon, invoice stamp, box print.

RECOMMENDED · site + documents

02 · The Wordmark

GPT Image 2

Stacked TERRA/FRESCA in brand type — closest to the website header. Needs the leaf moved off the first A (reads as an accent).

03 · The Container

GPT Image 2

The trading story in one icon: fresh cargo inside the box. Strong for the trading arm, decks, LinkedIn.

04 · The Crate Stamp

Nano Banana

Rustic ink-stamp texture with the mango. Beautiful on packaging, produce boxes, tote bags.

05 · The Leaf

Vector SVG · Recraft

Simplest mark of the set. Type feels more farmstand than trading house.

06 · TF Monogram

Vector SVG · Recraft

Reads sporty/motorsport — off-voice for produce. Kept for completeness.

Recommended System

The Seal (01) becomes the primary mark — favicon, stamps, boxes, social avatar — with the Wordmark (02) refined for the site header and documents (move the leaf off the A so it doesn't read as an accent). The Container (03) serves as the trading arm's secondary icon, and the Crate Stamp (04) is reserved for packaging. For Terra Fresca Market, the same seal swaps its green for Terracotta #C4572E. All vector files live in projects/brazil-fresh/brand/.
